rows: - 24 Nov, encrypted EAS source maps (n=1, no model). With the network publish doubled, archiving the 20,630,792-byte iOS map took 0.29 s and produced 6,542,052 bytes. Authenticating, decompressing, and parsing it through `wf android stack` took 0.18 s locally. A thrown exception from a minified Expo bundle resolved to its original TypeScript line. Keep gzip before encryption and retain only encrypted maps in the CI archive.
